THE NEW AIR-COOLED CHILLER SHALL BE INSTALLED WITH A BACNET COMPATIBLE CONTROLLER THAT MODULATES REFRIGERANT FLOW FOR COOLING BASED ON A PRE-DEFINED CHILLED WATER SUPPLY TEMPERATURE SET POINT. ONCE ENERGIZED, THE CHILLED WATER COIL SHALL OPERATE UNDER NORMAL CONDITIONS UNTIL SPACE TEMPERATURE DROPS TO 83°F (ADJ.) FOR UNOCCUPIED SETUP. RETURN AIR DAMPER SHALL REMAIN FULLY OPEN TO ALLOW FLOW THROUGH THE FAN COIL UNIT.
